Method of Attack: Downloader malware infecting devices to fetch shellcode, Cobalt Strike beacons, Grace malware, Teleport exfiltration tool, and Clop ransomware; exploitation of critical vulnerability CVE-2022-31199 in Netwrix Auditor servers to infect with Truebot; use of USB drives to infect computers with Raspberry Robin worm delivering IcedID, Bumblebee, and Truebot payloads; collection of Active Directory trust relations information for planning post-infection activity; use of shellcode or DLLs loaded in memory, execution of additional modules, uninstalling itself, or downloading DLLs, EXEs, BATs, and PS1 files
Impacted Systems: More than 1,500 systems worldwide infected with TrueBot; Netwrix Auditor servers vulnerable to CVE-2022-31199; desktops and Windows servers exposing SMB, RDP, and WinRM services; systems infected via USB drives with Raspberry Robin worm; systems in Mexico, Brazil, Pakistan, United States, former Soviet Union, Europe, Latin America, and Asia
Attack Vector: Exploitation of CVE-2022-31199 vulnerability; USB drive infection; public internet exposure of SMB, RDP, WinRM services; lateral movement using Cobalt Strike
Indicators of Compromise: CVE-2022-31199; use of Cobalt Strike beacons; scheduled tasks for ransomware execution; shellcode, DLLs, EXEs, BATs, PS1 files downloaded or executed; screenshots and video streaming from infected systems; Active Directory trust relations information exfiltrated
